findings.title: Sitemap lists URLs that redirect
findings.description: /server-table, /server-filter and /server-combined-table answer 307 to the same path plus default query params; TTFB 1.2-2.2 s.
findings.recommendation: Apply defaults in the loader and return 200 directly; prerender the default state.

findings.title: v9 pages duplicate v8 metadata and are not in the sitemap
findings.description: /v9/tree-table and /v9/spreadsheet-table share title and description with the v8 pages; all are self-canonical.
findings.recommendation: Unique v9 titles/descriptions, add to sitemap and llms.txt, or canonical to v8.

findings.title: Stale sitemap lastmod
findings.recommendation: Generate lastmod from real change dates.

findings.title: Overlapping filter pages

findings.title: Inconsistent table count

findings.title: robots.txt blocks AI assistant fetchers
